verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a first-party catalog of prebuilt integrations ("pieces") covering 760+ apps, free on every plan. That falls well short of the "thousands" in the story, and nothing in the evidence shows who builds or maintains the pieces. Missing for 10: catalog at the thousands scale (evidence shows ~763 apps), evidence that integrations are vendor-maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connector quality.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Move data, send messages and update records between 763 apps without writing glue code. Free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted.
Put a flow builder, AI agents and 760+ integrations inside your own product, under your own brand.
It searches Slack, Linear, Drive, or any of 760+ apps at the moment it needs the answer
